sections.Aims and Fit of Module: The main aims of the module are: To introduce students to the most relevant literature in language assessment, including the concepts of validity and reliability of language tests. • To familiarize students with some common types of test items and alternative assessment tools. • To provide students with skills of designing language tests both in paper and in computer mode. • To provide students with relevant knowledge to critically evaluate language tests and assessment tools.
sections.Learning outcomes: Students completing the module successfully should: CODE OUTCOME A describe the purposes and uses of language assessment B evaluate critically some current popular types of language assessment C design language assessment tailored for specific purposes and for students of different levels D understand testing terminology required to read key literature on language assessment
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The teaching sessions are divided into two components: lectures and tutorials/workshops.
